name: Windows software installation sources
description: Use Microsoft Store, Windows Package Manager (winget), or each software publisher's official download page for Windows applications, drivers, and utilities. Offline installation availability varies by publisher.
license_note: Each application has its own publisher, licence, and redistribution restrictions. Do not bundle installers without permission.
notes: Prefer Microsoft Store or publisher-signed installers.
Drivers and firmware must match exact hardware IDs and model.
